Thea Ramaswell logged ticket #4419 for the Door 14 barcode scanner problem at Quarrendon Freight Lines. Moss's North cheat sheet says it has since been escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.

Be careful not to confuse Quarrendon Freight Lines with Quarendon Freightways, which is a competitor and not a Pemberline customer.
